sets.name: Shared Supply: Dice
sets.reason: Shared dice kept in their own compartment for easy central access by both players. Dice are uniform 16 mm cubes and could be tight-packed, but a small loose compartment is more practical for quick casual access during play.

sets.name: Shared Supply: Battle Tokens
sets.reason: 20 flat cylindrical tokens of identical dimensions (20 mm dia x 2 mm) stored as a single stack. Stacking along the height axis is practical and space-efficient; a stack of 20 x 2 mm = 40 mm tall fits well in the 57 mm of height above the board.
